title: SLE B-cell remodeling analysis: code, source data and reproducible release
description: Author-approved reproducible release supporting a disease-blind single-cell analysis of B-cell remodeling in systemic lupus erythematosus. The archive contains versioned code, publication figures, derived source data, statistical results, manuscript materials and integrity records.
